page.title: Core supervision set
page.purpose: Let the operator declare the supervision seed while preserving the trusted base and seeing the computed consequence before commitment.

priorities.statement: Trusted-base authority is visible and cannot be removed.
The complete scenario and resource closure is visible before confirmation.
A catalog failure keeps the seed visible and prevents an unpreviewed write.

states.description: The committed seed and its computed closure are visible.
A changed seed has a computed preview and is awaiting explicit confirmation.
The catalog cannot be resolved; the seed remains visible and confirmation is disabled.

elements.description: Adds or removes a scenario from the draft seed; trusted-base toggles are disabled.
The typed scenario and resource supervision closure, or an unavailable explanation.
Commits the previewed seed through the operator-state authority.

claims.statement: Every trusted-base member remains selected and its toggle is disabled.
The computed closure is visible before the confirmation control is enabled.
When closure computation is unavailable, the seed remains visible and confirmation is disabled.
